name: Museum of Cham Sculpture
summary: Give this an hour on the river before you commit the day to the beach. A general ticket is 60,000 VND. The sandstone is from My Son and the other Cham sites. It is a museum morning, not a ruins day.
fee: 60,000 VND. Da Nang residents and students 20,000 VND. Children under 16 are free.
getThere: On the Han River in Hai Chau. Visit Da Nang lists 2 Thang 9 Street. The fee resolution lists 01 Trung Nu Vuong. Confirm the door.
